SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. .... ....
S.I., Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date November 19, 1937.

Subject The Masses National Salvation Travelling Propaganda Group -
formation. (大衆救亡旅行宣傳團)
Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by [Signature]

A new political organization entitled "The Masses
National Salvation Travelling Propaganda Group" came into
existence on November 7, 1937, with a temporary office on the
premises of the Kuan Chin Temple, 248 Amoy Road (Louza
District). The object of this group is the carrying out of
propaganda work of a national salvation nature in the interior,
especially in Honpo. The propaganda work will be in the
form of stage plays, singing songs and holding lectures. The
dramatic, chorus and lecturing sections are now being formed.

Persons who desire to join the Group and take part in
the above work are required to sign an oath taking form in
addition to guarantee paper and also must pay $1.00 as an
entrance fee. At present twenty-two members have registered
with the Group.

The following individuals have been elected as executive
members of the Group:-

Mr. Chiang Hwei Ling (姜煒林), Chairman, member of
a Red Cross Group organized by the Chinkiang Guild,
French Concession.

Mr. Hu Pei Tsung (胡佩宗), Executive committee member;
Clerk in the employ of the China Merchants' Naviga-
tion Company;

Mr. Liu Zai Heng (劉白痕), Executive committee member,
Supervisor of the No.131 Refugee Camp, 248 Amoy Road.

Miss Yang Wei Ling (楊惠敏), A girl guide,

Mr. Tsu Ying Woo (朱穎武),
Officer in charge of the No.131 Refugee Camp, 248 Amoy
Road.

Copy to D.C.A.
[Signature]
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1937年11月19日。

主题：民众救亡旅行宣传团——成立。（大衆救亡旅行宣傳團）
由特别调查员施士俭（Shih Ssu-chien）呈报 转呈 [签名]

一个新的政治组织“民众救亡旅行宣传团”于1937年11月7日成立，临时办事处设在爱多亚路248号（老闸区）关帝庙内。该团的目标是在内地，尤其是河南，开展具有救国性质的宣传工作。宣传工作的形式包括舞台剧、歌唱和举办讲座。戏剧、合唱及演讲部门目前正在组建中。

凡希望加入该团并参与上述工作的人员，除需签署保证书外，还需填写宣誓表，并缴纳1元作为入会费。目前已有二十二名成员在该团登记。

以下人员当选为该团执行委员：

姜煒林先生，主席，法租界镇江公所组织的红十字会小组成员。

胡佩宗先生，执行委员会委员；受雇于招商局的职员；

劉白痕先生，执行委员会委员，爱多亚路248号第131难民收容所管理员。

楊惠敏小姐，女童军，

朱穎武先生，
爱多亚路248号第131难民收容所负责人。
